name: Perfecto
description_en:
Perfecto is a product in the Software testing category. Its directory profile covers Bug Tracking, Continuous Integration, Seamless Integration, Test Recorder, Cross Device Testing, Reporting and Analysis, Parallel Testing, Scheduling.

Additional listed capabilities include Cross Browser Support, Parameterized Testing, Debugging, Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $83.0. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: record software defects and follow their progress; allocate times for appointments, resources or tasks; work with supported browsers in a common workflow; inspect program execution to investigate faults; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Perfecto 属于软件测试软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括缺陷跟踪、持续集成、集成能力、测试录制工具、跨设备测试、报表与分析、并行测试、排程管理。

资料还列出跨浏览器支持、参数化测试、代码调试、访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $83.0. 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：记录软件缺陷并跟踪处理进展；为预约、资源或任务安排时间；在同一流程中使用受支持的不同浏览器；检查程序执行过程以定位故障；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: Official perfecto.io home and pricing routes explicitly redirect to perforce.com product and quote pages, while current overview/release/operating documentation remains on help.perfecto.io. Those originals were read, but the shared same-registered-domain source rule cannot represent the current authority chain without false URLs or a shared schema change. The record remains incomplete; no domain rewrite or validator edit was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 官方 perfecto.io 首页及价格明确跳转 perforce.com 产品／报价页，当前概述／发布／操作文档仍在 help.perfecto.io。已读这些原页，但共享同注册域来源规则无法在不造 URL 或改共享模型的情况下表示完整权威链。记录仍未完成，未改域名或校验器。

research_gaps.en: Perfecto overview distinguishes manual/automation, scriptless/coded and public/enterprise cloud. Its trial cloud explicitly excludes app-store access; the current26.10 documentation lists individually controlled AI access and a staged Appium update. These are documentation observations, not a tested device, entitlement or reliability result.
research_gaps.zh: Perfecto 概述区分人工／自动、无脚本／代码及公共／企业云；试用云明确不支持应用商店访问，当前 26.10 文档列逐用户 AI 控制及分阶段 Appium 更新。这些仅是文档观察，不是设备、权益或可靠性实测。
